prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. FOUR distinct attack poses EXACT equal 2x2 TL TR BL BR: anticipation, held dangerous windup, release, recovery. 黒曜の処刑者. Distinct HORIZONTAL great sweep, never overhead: SAME double axe pulled to RIGHT shoulder, held beside shoulder with waist turned 15 degrees, broad LEFT horizontal waist-height sweep, upright neutral return. Both hands continuously grip SAME haft. Cape attached, restrained lag. Canonical reference is the immutable identity and color standard. LEFT-facing 3/4, refined JRPG pixel clusters, crisp stepped edges and dark outlines. SAME head size, torso proportions, armor, horns, wings and tail throughout. Exactly the original connected limbs; no extra feet, no claw elongation. TRUE transparent alpha. Absolutely NO ambient red haze, backdrop gradient, aura, shadow, floor, checkerboard, labels or watermark. Every pixel outside the sharply outlined silhouette is alpha=0. Orange light ONLY inside scales/fins/armor. Full complete silhouette including every blade, tail, wing and claw inside its cell with ample clear margin, and empty gutters. Do not bake full projectile, beam, impact or ground VFX into the body sheet. Only tiny attached emission/core light allowed.
